stem: A discrete random variable X has P(X = 0) = 0.1, P(X = 1) = 0.3, P(X = 2) = k. Also P(X = 3) = 0.2. All probabilities must sum to 1. What is the value of k?

per_option_rationale.rationale: Computing 1 - (0.1 + 0.3) = 0.6, omitting P(X = 3) = 0.2 from the subtraction.
Copying P(X = 1) = 0.3 as the answer, confusing k with an existing probability in the table.
Computing 1 - (0.1 + 0.2 + 0.2) = 0.5, misreading P(X = 1) as 0.2 instead of 0.3.

explanation:
1. The probabilities of all values of a discrete random variable must sum to 1.
2. Known values: 0.1 + 0.3 + 0.2 = 0.6.
3. KEY STEP: k = 1 - 0.6 = 0.4.
4. Omitting any known probability from the sum leads to an overestimate of k.
